items.headline: Small plane crashes in Fort Ann
items.excerpt: A small plane crashed Friday into a field in the Fort Ann area, according to the Washington County Sheriff's Office.

items.headline: Warren County passes bans on kratom, nitrous oxide sales
items.excerpt: The Warren County Board of Supervisors passed two laws unanimously on Friday that will ban kratom and nitrous oxide product sales throughout the county.

items.headline: State Police identify victim of fatal Rensselaerville crash
items.excerpt: New York State Police announced that the victim of a fatal car crash in Rensselaerville has been publicly identified

items.headline: Malta man pleads guilty to attempted murder
items.excerpt: The Saratoga County District Attorney's Office announced on Friday that Shayne Vaccaro of Malta has pleaded guilty in an attempted murder case.

items.headline: Well-drilling truck reportedly stolen in Fulton County
items.excerpt: A well-drilling truck was reportedly stolen in the rural town of Oppenheim, New York State Police said in a Facebook post Friday.

items.headline: Durham man accused of sexually abusing a 12-year-old
items.excerpt: A Greene County man was arrested on Tuesday after reports of a previous sexual assault, according to New York State Police. Troopers said 37-year-old Benjamin Prinzivalli is facing multiple charges.

items.headline: BOCES carpentry students selling holiday decorations
items.excerpt: Carpentry students at Capital Region BOCES are using their skills to embrace the holidays.

items.headline: Original Deep Purple guitarist coming to Woodstock
items.excerpt: The Bearsville Theater in Woodstock will be hosting an early spring performance by Blackmore's Night, featuring legendary rock guitarist Ritchie Blackmore.

items.headline: Schenectady County Holiday Parade: How to vote for a float
items.excerpt: Saturday, November 21st is the 57th annual Schenectady County Holiday Parade.

items.headline: Deadly Schenectady house fire started on back porch, fire chief says
items.excerpt: The Schenectady Fire Department on Thursday updated the public about the origin of a fire that killed a 4-year-old girl and injured one firefighter earlier this week.

items.headline: Water main break in Albany
items.excerpt: Utility crews addressed a water main break in Albany on Friday morning.

items.headline: 'The Gilded Age' renewed by HBO for fifth season
items.excerpt: "The Gilded Age" is coming back for a fifth season. The HBO series, which was partially shot in the Capital Region, has been renewed for a season 5 as the fourth season is currently airing.

items.headline: Formerly incarcerated man admits to sending white powder in letter to prison Superintendent
items.excerpt: On Nov. 12, a formerly incarcerated man admitted to a federal charge after sending a threatening note containing white powder to the Coxsackie Correctional Facility superintendent. Federal prosecutors said James McDonaugh, of Manhattan, pleaded guilty to conveying a hoax.

items.headline: Albany International Airport, Amtrak prepare for busy holiday travel
items.excerpt: Those planning trips in and out of the Capital Region for the Thanksgiving holiday are being urged to plan accordingly. Officials with the Albany International Airport and Amtrak said they're gearing up for what is expected to be one of the busiest Thanksgiving travel weeks.
